en.hero-tagline: I build things that solve real problems — from AI apps to hackathon wins.
en.about-bio: Computer Engineering student at La Salle Campus Barcelona (2025–2029), passionate about building tech with real impact. I've worked on embedded systems at MICA ECO (C++ / ESP32), taught programming at Algorithmics, and won two hackathons. I enjoy projects that promote sustainability, efficiency, and social good — always learning, always shipping.
en.exp-algo-b1: Teaching programming, computational thinking, and game development to students aged 6–18 in small, dynamic groups.
en.exp-algo-b2: Translating complex technical concepts (logic, algorithms) into engaging lessons using innovative methodologies.
en.exp-mica-b1: Embedded software development with C++ for ESP32 microcontrollers on the Mica water recirculation system.
en.exp-mica-b2: System architecture design leveraging FreeRTOS and PlatformIO for real-time task management.
en.exp-mica-b3: Hands-on experience with Git / GitHub for version control, issue tracking and collaborative workflows.
en.exp-sales-b1: Planning and running educational activities and summer camps for children.
en.exp-sales-b2: Managing groups of children, resolving conflicts, and communicating with families.
